coherence_review.scope: Viewed integrated reduced tavern/well/homes/awning/dome and full tavern reverse; no new mixed material discrepancy observed in this sample. No claim that these five regions cover all76 assets.
findings: Tavern furniture wood remains coherent with framed wall bays and green roof courses; small props fit the existing material hierarchy.
Homes retained straw/cart/ladder/signs remain stylistically consistent beside new stone surrounds.
Awning weapons crates/carts have consistent worn wood and metal; black projected light cards are expected diffuse-only preview.
Dome pink/ochre trees and iron fence coexist with muted green roof; ivy/bush palette coherent.
Well groundcover can appear floating without terrain; not evidence of changed contacts in this no-terrain preview.

decision: RETAIN76 on recorded individual asset grounds, subject to separately pending full goal integration/client limitations
